use_case: AI resume screening and candidate ranking: scores each applicant 0-100 against the job order and (until 2026-08-31) auto-advanced scores of 70+ to the recruiter queue
vendor_or_model: Third-party AI screening vendor (resume parsing and matching model) integrated into the ATS
source_evidence: EV-039 (marketplace order, terms and configuration); EV-010 (auto-advance switched on 2026-03-02); EV-035 (billing); EV-050 (survey)
data_categories: Resumes; application answers; work history; certifications; prior ATS activity. No SSNs, I-9 data, or consumer reports
human_in_the_loop: Changed 2026-08-31: sort-only mode; recruiters review every applicant who meets the job order's minimum requirements; no automatic rejection or advancement
applicable_laws: Title VII 703(a), (b), (k) (42 U.S.C. 2000e-2); ADEA (29 U.S.C. 623(b); 631(a)); ADA (42 U.S.C. 12112(b)(6)); FCRA if third-party data is added (15 U.S.C. 1681b); Fla. Stat. 501.171(2) (vendor security). Not applicable while Florida-only: NYC LL 144; Colorado SB26-189; Illinois HB 3773; California ADS regulations; Connecticut PA 26-15
status: In production (sort-only mode since 2026-08-31); bias re-test due 2026-11-30

status: In production; prompt guidance and review checklist due 2026-10-31
